description: Sequencer that steps along the orbit of one point in a Mandelbrot-style fractal, turning the real and imaginary parts of each iteration into two CVs, with the map drawn on the screen

params.text: The real part of the value the fractal starts iterating from; the knob travels to 1.8 either way but the value is clamped at 1.5, so the last of the travel does nothing
The imaginary part of the value the fractal starts iterating from; the knob travels to 1.8 either way but the value is clamped at 1.5, so the last of the travel does nothing
The real part of the constant added at every iteration, which is the point on the map the sequence is taken from, -2 to 2
The imaginary part of the constant added at every iteration, which is the point on the map the sequence is taken from, -2 to 2
Sets the exponent the fractal is raised to at every iteration, 1.75 to 5
Sets how many steps the sequence runs before it wraps round, 1 to 64
Sets the step the sequence starts from, 0 to 64
Sets how many steps behind the current one the two shift register outputs are read from, 1 to 4
Sets the span of the X CV output: 0 to 2V, -2V to 2V, or -5V to 5V
Sets the span of the Y CV output: 0 to 2V, -2V to 2V, or -5V to 5V
Moves the whole drawn map left and right, -1.8 to 1.8, and with it the window the Soil knobs are clamped to
Moves the whole drawn map up and down, -1.8 to 1.8, and with it the window the Soil knobs are clamped to
Narrows the drawn map around its centre, 1 to 15; the window shrinks with the square of the setting, and the CV outputs are multiplied by one plus the base-ten logarithm of it
Slews the X CV output, from none at fully counter-clockwise to about one clock interval at fully clockwise
Slews the Y CV output, from none at fully counter-clockwise to about one clock interval at fully clockwise
Steps through six fractals — Mandelbrot, Burning Ship, Beetlebrot, Bird, Daisybrot and Unicron; the hover text names the one in use and marks the last two as costly to draw
Swaps the Soil and Mutagens values over, which gives the Julia set of the chosen fractal
Negates the X and Y CV outputs and both shift register outputs
Steps the Aux output through its four modes — Sum, Magnitude, Centroid and Beginning of Cycle
Negates the imaginary parts of Soil and Mutagens before the fractal is iterated, which flips the map top to bottom
Advances the sequence by one step each time it is pressed, on both axes at once
Returns both axes to the step set by Start; a cable in Reset In replaces this button
Flips the sequence between running forwards and backwards; a cable in Reverse In replaces this button
Steps the drawing through four styles — Blind Lines, which draws nothing and costs the least, MonoChrome, Flower and BuddhaBrot
Copies the point set by the Soil knobs into the Move knobs, centring the map on it, and zeroes the Soil knobs so the sequence stays where it was
Copies the Move knob positions into the Mutagens knobs

inputs.text: Each rise past 1V advances the sequence by one step; this clock drives the X axis, and the Y axis as well when Yi-Clock has no cable
Each rise past 1V advances the Y axis alone, so the two axes can run at different rates; with no cable the Y axis follows Clock In
A rise past 1V returns both axes to the step set by Start
Each rise past 1V flips the sequence between running forwards and backwards
Replaces the length knob, 0V giving 1 step and 5V giving 64; the voltage is cut to whole volts first, so only six lengths can be reached
Replaces the Start knob, 0V giving step 0 and 5V step 64; the voltage is cut to whole volts first, so only six starting points can be reached
Replaces the Smooth knob for the X axis and runs the other way round from it: 0V gives the most slew and 5V none
Replaces the Smooth knob for the Y axis and runs the other way round from it: 0V gives the most slew and 5V none
Added to the outer Mutagens knob, 5V moving it by 1; the total is clamped to 1.5 either way
Added to the inner Mutagens knob, 5V moving it by 1; the total is clamped to 1.5 either way
Added to the outer Soil knob, 5V moving it by 1; the total is clamped to the edges of the drawn map
Inverted before it is added to the inner Soil knob, so a positive voltage moves the point the opposite way from the knob; the total is clamped to the edges of the drawn map
The absolute value of the voltage is added to the Petals knob, so a negative voltage raises the exponent as much as the same positive one does, and the total can pass the knob's own maximum of 5

outputs.text: The real part of the step being played, scaled to the X Range switch and slewed by Smooth
The imaginary part of the step being played, scaled to the Y Range switch and slewed by Smooth
The real part of the step a set number of places behind the one being played, scaled to the X Range switch, with no slew applied
The imaginary part of the step a set number of places behind the one being played, scaled to the Y Range switch, with no slew applied
5V for as long as the clock driving the X axis is above 1V, and 0V otherwise
5V for as long as the clock driving the Y axis is above 1V, and 0V otherwise
Carries whichever Aux mode is chosen: the sum of the two CV outputs, their magnitude, the average value of the whole sequence, or a 10V pulse 0.8 seconds long at the start of each cycle

notes: the screen draws the fractal itself, with a pale blue square at the point the Soil knobs set, a green square at the step being played, and a line joining the steps of the sequence in order
every output is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Soil as Polar — reads the outer Soil knob as a radius and the inner one as an angle, instead of as two coordinates
